column3: “They summoned them” is rendered “The more they called them, The more they went from them”; NASB adds “kept.”
“He took them on his arms” is rendered “I took them in My arms,” following a different reading.
“Cords of humankind” is rendered “cords of a man,” and “lift a yoke on” “lifts the yoke from.”
“They have refused to repent” is rendered “they refused to return to Me”; NASB adds “But.”
“Bars” is rendered “gate bars,” and “from their schemes” “because of their counsels.”
“Hung up to my apostasy” is rendered “bent on turning from Me”; “to a height they call on him” is rendered “they call them to the One on high.” The meaning is uncertain.
“My heart has been changed on me” is rendered “My heart is turned over within Me”; “grown warm” is rendered “kindled,” and NASB adds “All.”
“The burning of my anger” is rendered “My fierce anger”; “rage” is rendered “wrath.”
“Tremble” is rendered “come trembling,” and “bird … dove” “birds … doves.”
MT 12:1. NASB renders “roamed with God and with the holy ones faithful” as “unruly against God, Even against the Holy One who is faithful”; the meaning is uncertain.
